source: Enables high quality but slow calculation of the bounding box for perfect results on complex shape meshes with rotation/scale
target: Aktiverar högkvalitativ men långsam beräkning av begränsningsboxen för perfekta resultat på komplexa polygonmaskor med rotation eller skalning
note: Blender three-dimensional bounding-box terminology reviewed in Object Align context on 2026-11-09.

source: Calculate the center of geometry based on the current pivot point (median, otherwise bounding box)
target: Beräkna geometrins centrum utifrån den aktuella vridningspunkten (median, annars begränsningsbox)
note: Blender three-dimensional bounding-box terminology reviewed in Object Origin context on 2026-11-09.

source: Geometry to compute the bounding box of. Instances have to be realized before the full bounding box can be computed
target: Geometri vars begränsningsbox ska beräknas. Instanser måste realiseras innan den fullständiga begränsningsboxen kan beräknas
note: Blender three-dimensional bounding-box terminology reviewed in Geometry Nodes context on 2026-11-09.

source: Bounding box volume must be greater than 0
target: Begränsningsboxens volym måste vara större än 0
note: Blender three-dimensional bounding-box terminology reviewed in Geometry Nodes context on 2026-11-09.
